stories.title: Provider Search Input/Output Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and validate request/response schema for provider search including free-text query, normalized location inputs (state/city/zip resolved to county via FIPS), specialty filters (NUCC codes), and structured result payload (provider identity, location, specialty match attribution, relevance score). Enforce strict Pydantic validation and a deterministic scoring contract compatible with the facade.

stories.title: Core Provider Search Logic (Vector + Taxonomy Fallback)
stories.description: Implement provider search orchestration using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embedding generation, including explicit fallback triggers (low relevance threshold, sparse result set) to taxonomy-based search via NUCC codes. Include deterministic ranking, deduplication, and multi-stage geographic filtering (FIPS/county resolution). Ensure consistent behavior under ambiguous queries and partial matches.

stories.title: Find Care Facade Integration with Specialty Resolution
stories.description: Integrate provider search into FindCare facade, coordinating with specialty_service for dual-pipeline specialty identification (regex + vector). Define clear handoff of resolved NUCC codes into search and ensure orchestration order aligns with tool_router-driven chat workflows.

stories.title: Provider Search API and Tool Exposure
stories.description: Expose provider search via FastAPI and tool_router as an allowlisted tool. Enforce validated inputs, structured outputs, explicit error contracts, and compatibility with Anthropic tool-use flow. Include debug_logger instrumentation and ensure GOV-004 compliant dispatch.

stories.title: Provider Search Tests and End-to-End Validation
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering schema validation, embedding generation, fallback trigger logic, ranking/deduplication, specialty integration, and API/tool_router flow. Validate behavior under sparse datasets, ambiguous queries, and degraded embedding responses, ensuring fallback correctness.
